expectations.text: Report file exists at outputs/report.md and is non-empty (>1000 chars).
Report cites or runs the failing test (mentions tests/test_search.py or test_search_finds_user_signed_up_with_mixed_case).
expectations.evidence: §2 'Repro (deterministic)' runs `python3 -m unittest tests.test_search.SearchTests.test_search_finds_user_signed_up_with_mixed_case -v` and quotes the AssertionError.

expectations.text: Report contains a 5-whys chain as a numbered list with at least 4 distinct Why questions.
expectations.evidence: §4 has 5 numbered Why items, each a different question.

expectations.text: Each Why link in the chain cites concrete evidence — at least 4 file:line-style citations appear in the chain.
expectations.evidence: Citations include app/search.py:7-9, app/db.py:32-36, app/signup.py:10-15, app/db.py:1, app/db.py:7-11, grep commands with results.

expectations.text: Report explicitly labels symptom / proximate cause / root cause.
expectations.evidence: §5 'Symptom / proximate / root' has all three labelled with their statements.

expectations.text: Root cause identified is the missing email normalization at write time, NOT merely 'search uses == comparison'.
expectations.evidence: Root cause stated as 'No enforced invariant that stored email = canonical email, combined with no shared chokepoint that normalizes at the boundary.' Fix lands in db.insert + db.find_by_email.

expectations.text: Sibling sweep identifies at least two of: app/password_reset.py, app/invite.py, app/signup.py.
expectations.evidence: §6 sibling table lists all four: search.py, signup.py (P1 duplicate), invite.py, password_reset.py.

expectations.text: Report presents both a symptom fix and a root-cause fix as distinct options with a recommendation.
expectations.evidence: §8a symptom fix, §8b root-cause fix, §8c recommends 8b with reasons.

expectations.text: Counterfactual section confirms the recommended fix would make the failing test pass.
expectations.evidence: §8.5 walks through the repro under the fix, confirms 'Repro would not fire', names which links break.

expectations.text: Prevention proposal includes at least one of: regression test, guardrail, or doc update.
expectations.evidence: §9 includes 1) regression tests, 2) guardrails (CanonicalEmail value object, invariant assertion), 3) docs (INV-EMAIL-CANONICAL).

expectations.text: Load-bearing assumptions are enumerated as a numbered list with validation results.
expectations.evidence: §7 lists 5 numbered assumptions, each with How validated and Result fields.
